run_create_metadata_idx: run the script to generate OpenAI embeddings for view descriptions and save them to a CSV file
run_main_with_config: run main with a views catalog path, config.ini path, and output CSV path as CLI arguments
build_embedding_index: build a metadata embedding index by reading view descriptions and generating text-embedding-ada-002 vectors
review_main: review the main function that reads a views catalog, generates embeddings, and stores them in a CSV
refactor_main: refactor main to use argparse instead of raw sys.argv for the views catalog, config, and output path arguments
